title: Keep a freshly vended spoke from deadlocking on IPs, arch, and Karpenter

requirements.text: Cilium ENI-mode per-node IP limit (~35 on m7g.large) is exceeded → pods stuck `ContainerCreating` with `cilium-cni: no IPs available`.

Karpenter, itself scheduled on a saturated bootstrap node, loses DNS and can't resolve the EC2 API (`lookup ec2.us-west-2.amazonaws.com: i/o timeout`) → can't launch nodes → can't relieve the pressure. Deadlock.
A dev/smoke addon profile that installs a minimal set (skip falco/trivy/gpu-operator/neuron/grafana-prometheus for non-prod), and/or
Size the bootstrap node group for the catalog (more/bigger nodes, or prefix-delegation for more IPs/node), and/or
Give Karpenter a priorityClass + anti-affinity so it isn't stranded on a saturated bootstrap node.

title: fix: tick wrapped criteria under the last Acceptance criteria heading (#2630)

requirements.text: the criteria sit under a **second** `## Acceptance criteria` heading — one that replaces an
the checkbox text **wraps over several lines**.

With two unfenced `## Acceptance criteria` headings in the body, the tick applies under the last one: a matcher held only by a criterion under the last heading ticks it and leaves the superseded criteria above it unticked, and a matcher held only above the last heading exits 3. Pinned by a case in `skills/tdd/scripts/tests/py/test_tick_issue_criterion.py`.

A criterion whose checkbox text wraps over several lines is ticked when the matcher occurs in any of its lines, and only the checkbox line is rewritten. Pinned by a case with a three-line wrapped criterion whose matcher sits in its second line.

The script exits 0 only when the issue body it writes back differs from the one it read; when the tick changed nothing it exits 3 and writes nothing. Pinned by a case that feeds a body where the matched line is already ticked.
